title: Basketball Stars 2026
description: Basketball Stars is a cool 2 player basketball game by MadPuffers. Prepared for the 2025 basketball season. Choose your team and enter a challenging tournament. Control your player to perform awesome dunks and 3-pointers to win the game. Feel free to block and slap your opponent to knock him out and get the ball, and pay attention to the supershot bar on the top of the screen. Once fully loaded, you can use the hot special dunk from wherever you stand; it never fails. Be the best player!

title: Basketball Stars
description: Basketball Stars is a cool 2 player basketball game by MadPuffers. Choose your team and enter a challenging tournament. Control your player to perform awesome dunks and 3 pointers to win the game. Feel free to block and slap your opponent to knock him out and get the ball, and pay attention to the supershot bar on the top of the screen, once it’s fully loaded, you can use the hot special dunk from wherever you are standing, it never fails. Be the best player on the field. Enjoy Basketball Stars!

title: Hoop World 3D
description: Hoop World 3D is a flip-and-dunk game that brings basketball to a whole new dimension! Get your timing right or you'll fall short of the net and fall flat on your face.

title: Basketball Fever
description:
Get ready for endless basketball fun! Basketball Fever features four exciting basketball challenges anyone can enjoy. 

Sharpen your aim, beat your high score, or just enjoy quick bursts of arcade-style fun, Basketball Fever delivers nonstop action that’s easy to pick up and hard to put down. It’s the ultimate way to test your reflexes, timing, and accuracy.

Simple controls, smooth gameplay, and satisfying physics make every shot feel rewarding.

title: Head Basketball
description: With exceptional shots, Head Basketball is a simple yet entertaining basketball game. The ball must be shot into the hoop of your opponent. Two points for each shot. It is imperative that you surpass your rivals in points before the time runs out.

title: Basketball Rush
description: This isn’t just about shooting — it's about precision, patience and strategy. As you score, the game intensifies, but with helpful power-ups at your disposal, you’ll be ready for anything. Unlock a variety of unique ball skins to customize your game and add even more excitement.

title: 3D Basketball.io Dunk Sport
description:
Sports Basketball is a thrilling 3D basketball game that will keep you entertained for hours. Whether you're a basketball fan or just love fast-paced Sports games Fun

Powered by R.bin Sarl Developer

title: Jump Up 3D: Basketball Game
description: Jump Up 3D is a sports basketball game where you shoot to get that slam dunk, but the one hitch is you're doing it by jumping on a trampoline. Not your ordinary basketball game, this one promises and delivers the excitement! Take aim, bounce on the trampoline, and score baskets before your opponent. With intuitive controls and addictive gameplay, it tests your precision and unleashes your inner dunk master.

title: Basketball Life 3d
description: Ready for the wonderful basketball challenge? Basketball Life 3D is a fun and creative sports game that tests your skills and timing! From classic hoop challenges to trick shots, every level is packed with excitement.

title: Basketball
description: Basketball is a 3d game where players navigate a basketball into a hoop. It features physics-based gameplay,  a fun and addictive game that challenges players' timing, accuracy, and dexterity.

title: Basket Sport Stars
description: A great basket challenge begins with random characters and with random basketball arenas with the Basket Sport Stars game! Play single or 2 player! The game consists of many levels, characters, and various game modes like Tournament, Quick Matches, 2 player Matches, and Practice Matches. You can play any of these modes for free, without unlocking. Pick most of the characters for free and start shooting your opponent's basket hoop!

title: On Fire Basketball Shots
description: The gym is packed, and the crowd is roaring! The scoreboard's ticking down, and your team is trailing. The only way to win is to sink blazing basketball shots from the court. You're the star player, but the pressure's on—every shot counts, and the hoop's rim is red-hot, making each attempt trickier!

title: Basketball Simulator 3D
description: Basketball Simulator 3D is the sports simulation game in which you can prove your basketball skills by making shots from all different distances. First select your favorite team and then make shots before the time runs out. Make as many as you can to get a high score that you can be proud of. Use WASD or Arrows to run, Mouse to make shoot (press LMB to detrmen shot fource), P to pause the game.

title: Basketball Tournament 3D
description: Follow our path of a brand new Basketball Tournament 3D game to pursue your dream! Join the free throw competition, practice your skills in six different modes, you will never feel bored in our basketball games! Rules in our basketball games are different. As a free shot game, you get 2 points for throwing basketball into the loop, and 3 points by creating a clean shot, disregard the distance. Receive fire ball bonus by scoring continuously, and use backboard to score to get backboard bonus!

title: Super Hoops Basketball
description: Super Hoops Basketball is a puzzle game. In this game, you have to deliver a Basketball to that Hoop. Collect the stars along the way but be careful not to turn the platforms too much or else it’ll be game over!

title: Basket Swap
description: Slide into the gray blocks to help you position the ball and grid correctly. If you're stuck, click on the arrow in the bottom left corner to undo your last move, or press R to restart the level.

title: Basket Shot
description: Anyone may enjoy the swelteringly popular arcade game Basket Shot! Become the next basketball superstar by shooting baskets and unlocking new balls!

title: Flick Basketball
description: It is everyone's dream to have unlimited coins for arcade machine. Now this classic sports game is free to play! Challenge yourself and win coins, remember every shot and every second counts! It is highly addictive sports game that you can not stop playing! Pick the ball and flick it towards the hoop, try to reach the goal within time limit. Clean shot will be 3 points! The higher score you get, the longer you can play!

title: Bounce Dunk Basketball
description: Love basketball? Want to master the art of bouncing and dunking? In Bounce Dunk - Basketball, you must skillfully control the balls bounce to make perfect shots and get high scores. Tap the screen to control the angle and strength of the basketball so that the ball bounces perfectly into the basket. Or destroy enemies, get coins, etc.

title: Ball Dunk Fall
description: In Ball Dunk Fall, your challenge is to guide a constantly falling ball through hoops of varying difficulties by tapping the screen. Test your precision and reflexes as you navigate through tricky obstacles. With each successful dunk, experience the thrill of victory and aim for high scores!

title: Ketchapp Basketball
description: Swipe the ball towards the hoop to score. There are 4 modes to compete with your friends and globally. Can you become Ketchapp Basketball star? Collect stars to unlock new balls. Improve your skills and become the master of the hoop.

title: Dunk Challenge
description: Shoot and score with Dunk Challenge, a 2D basketball game that will make you bounce with joy. You will play as a basketball shooter. You will also enjoy a new explosive mode that adds more fun and challenge to your gameplay. You will tap the screen to shoot and use your 14 bullets wisely to make the ball rebound and land in the hoop. You will also collect purple diamonds and explore the store, where you can find 15 different ball skins to customize your game. Don’t miss this addictive game!

title: Basketball Damage
description: Basketball bounce is an addictive endless basketball game. You can control the ball as you like. Time your tapping perfectly to score before the clock runs out. Keep going as long as you can!

title: Boolu Bask
description: Dunk Ball game is an exciting sports-based game that brings the thrills of basketball right to your device. The focus of the game is on scoring points by aiming each ball into the moving basket. Show off your agility, precision, and timing as you handle each ball with finesse and drop them into the basket for maximum points.
